title: package.yml
description: The metadata of one kit package, packages/<name>/package.yml. Each key is described in docs/packages.md.

description.description: One line, shown by kit packages.

default.description: When true, the package is active unless removed. kit install activates every default package.

items.description: The name of another package in the release, activated with this one. kit packages remove refuses it while this one is active.

The name of a member of this bundle: another package in the release, activated with this one. Unlike a dependency, a member can be removed on its own; kit packages remove records it as excluded, and kit update leaves it out.

^[a-z_]+$.description: The default value of a template key, written @key@ in the package's templates.

policy.description: The policy rules the package sets, with the same keys as kit.yml's policy: each a pattern, or a map of a pattern and the remedy a refusal names. The kit package's are the kit's defaults; kit.yml's policy wins over them.

expects.description: Lines the package expects in files the repository owns, such as the line that includes a delivered file (extends: [.kit/lefthook.yml]). kit check reports each missing line with its remedy. The kit never writes these lines.

path.description: The file, relative to the repository root.

pattern.description: An extended regular expression some line of the file must match.

remedy.description: What to add, and why, printed when no line matches.

notices.description: What happens next, told to the person when the kit places a path afresh, or merges an entry into it that was not there: on kit install, kit packages add, and kit update.

path.description: The file, relative to the repository root, as the package delivers it.

text.description: The line printed after the path, in the indicative or the imperative.

rule.description: A policy rule: its pattern, an extended regular expression in the subset RE2 also reads, empty to turn the rule off, or a map of the pattern and the remedy a refusal names after it.
